name: press-jelly
title: Press Jelly
description: A primary button that squashes like jelly under the finger and wobbles back on release.

perf.budget: Two scale springs per press, started on the UI thread; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: A 2% press-in instead of the squash and wobble.
a11y.screenReader: Button role with disabled and busy states; 'activate' presses it.
a11y.touchTarget: 48 pt (md) or 56 pt (lg) tall, at least 96 pt wide.
